tools.name: craft_audit_code_snippet
tools.description: Run the full 20-rule CraftCI static, UI posture, and billing-safety audit on a code snippet or file list and return score, grade, and remediations.

tools.name: craft_verify_billing_safety
tools.description: Audit TypeScript/JavaScript payment and webhook handlers against the 5 critical Financial & Webhook Security rules (401/403, server SKU pricing, HMAC, idempotency, zero PII logs).

tools.name: craft_score_posture_report
tools.description: Evaluate HTML, CSS, or TSX UI templates across CraftCI's 10 layout and accessibility rules including 5-posture overflow guards, 44px targets, tabular-nums, and reduced-motion.

tools.name: craft_generate_ci_gate
tools.description: Generate a ready-to-paste GitHub Actions workflow YAML and Markdown CraftCI gate configuration for a target minimum score.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "craft_audit_code_snippet" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
